story: You are a researcher at the University of California, Berkeley, conducting a longitudinal study called 'The Future Scholars Initiative.' This study aims to collect comprehensive data on various aspects of student education from kindergarten through college to understand how different factors influence academic outcomes and overall educational success. You are gathering information on demographics, school environment, technology usage, and extracurricular activities to identify key predictors of student achievement and engagement.
